access_rights_boundary: public player; local play and pause only; no account, trial, subscription, share, navigation, or external mutation; audio content not retained; evidence only
accessibility_localization_evidence: named Headspace meditation slider, progress bar, elapsed time, total duration, and active player control expose playback progress without relying on audio content
consequence_risk: listener may not know whether the meditation has started or how much remains
content_object_schema_hypothesis: audio-playback progress status with elapsed and total duration
system_status: playback advanced from 0:00 to 0:16 of 1:00 before being paused
trigger: listener activates the public mini-guided meditation player
visible_action_recovery: pause playback or continue listening locally
